cmd: dirs=$(find {cwd}/hello/evals -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name results 2>/dev/null); test -n "$dirs" || exit 1; for d in $dirs; do { test -f $d/prompt.md || { test -f $d/request.md && test -f $d/human.md; }; } && { ls $d/graders/*.md >/dev/null 2>&1 || test -f $d/checks.json; } || exit 1; done

dirs=$(find {cwd}/hello/evals -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name results 2>/dev/null); test -n "$dirs" || exit 1; for d in $dirs; do n=$(ls $d/graders/*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l); m=0; test -f $d/checks.json && m=$(python3 -I -c "import json,sys; print(len(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))))" $d/checks.json); test $((n+m)) -ge 3 || exit 1; done
